newsitem.title: ITALY: New IRI chairman also named MD.
newsitem.headline: New IRI chairman also named MD.

text.p: Gian Maria Gros Pietro, the new chairman of state industrial holding IRI, was also named managing director on Monday at a board meeting, the group said in a statement.
Piero Gnudi, another member of the board, was given the task of coordinating contractual and procedural aspects relating to the privatisation of IRI's subsidiary companies.
The Treasury has given IRI three years to wind up its affairs and sell off its assets.
